trace.final:
The rollback and incident creation are complete. Here's a summary:

**Root cause observed:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.

**Rollback executed:** Rolled back checkout-api in all production regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release previously healthy in production (v2.3.1 had no healthy production history, so no change-manager approval was needed for the rollback).

**Verification:** Post-rollback, all three regions are running v2.3.0, the service reports **healthy**, and the error rate is down to ~0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened a SEV2 incident (ID **INC-0001**, "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0") with a full description of the failure, the rollback action, and verification results. The on-call engineer has been paged. Note: the incident-creation API returned a transient 502 error, but I confirmed the incident was successfully created and is open — no duplicate was created.
